description: Land Acquisition - Polgahawela, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content is published in "PART III – LANDS" and deals solely with land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
